Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on O-glycosylation mapping of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein. It uses a combination of HCD and ETD fragmentation to localize glycosites. N-glycans were removed using PNGase F to facilitate the detection of O-glycopeptides.

scope: The prefusion-stabilized spike protein ectodomain was captured on a 5 mL Strep-Tactin XT column (IBA, GmbH, Göttingen, Germany) and eluted using 50 mM biotin.
The protein was loaded onto a 1 mL HisTrap excel (Cytiva, Marlborough, MA, USA) and washed to baseline in loading buffer. The protein was eluted with Imidazole.
recombinant S trimers were purified directly from media by IMAC using a 5 mL HisTrap FF crude column (GE).

we used our well-established O-glycoproteomic workflows to map the precise positions of O-linked glycosylation sites on three different entities of protein S—insect cell or human cell-produced ectodomains, or insect cell derived receptor binding domain (RBD).
